sam_runtime: quick heads-up — ran a perf sweep on mistral-7b with AWQ and GPTQ candidates; seeing a 12-18% p95 latency regression vs baseline int8 on long-rope sequences (>2048). logs attached below.
lee_ml: ugh. is this correlated with RoPE scaling tweak from earlier? or kernel selection fallback?
sam_runtime: i instrumented kernel chooser. fallback to the generic matmul kernel spikes when head_kv stride changes. trace snippet:
```
KERNEL SELECT: preferred=quant_fused_gemm_v2 fallback=generic_gemm reason=rope_stride_mismatch
LATENCY: preferred=12.3ms fallback=28.9ms
CONTEXT_LEN=4096, SEQ_DISTRIBUTION=heavy-tail
```
jordan_perf: can you paste the batcher config used for the sweep?
sam_runtime: ran two variants:
- dynbatcher: microbatch=8, tail_timeout=4ms, prefetch=on
- conservative: microbatch=1, tail_timeout=1ms, prefetch=off
Observed worst regressions when prefetch=on + dynbatcher because prefetch warms hot KV with different rope scale which triggers kernel miss.
lee_ml: interesting. AWQ kernels expect certain scale/quant offsets per head? might be mismatch when RoPE scale changes per model family (mistral vs mixtral)
ana_sre: deploy-bot reports one rollback yesterday to a safe quant profile — did that change the default routing?
deploy-bot: deploy 233.12 promoted quant-profile=awq_mistral_v2 -> traffic=100% at 2026-02-18T09:12Z
jordan_perf: hypothesis: when prefetch primes KV cache with a different stride, the kernel selector rejects the optimized fused kernel because cached KV layout != expected layout (head_dim alignments). leads to expensive copy+generic path.
sam_runtime: yep. replicated locally by toggling rope_scale param in the loader: small delta (~0.015) was enough.
lee_ml: what's the accuracy delta between AWQ and GPTQ here? need to ensure not sacrificing quality for perf.
sam_runtime: on our calibration prompts (n=1200), AWQ_mistral_v2 delta vs fp16: -0.6% exact-match on structured QA, GPTQ_mistral_v3 -0.2%. so AWQ slightly worse but within flags for cost-savings.
jordan_perf: plan: 1) add kernel selector check to accept compatible rope-scale delta within epsilon (0.02) 2) add a prefetch guard: avoid priming KV that changes stride for already in-flight requests 3) re-run dynbatch params with microbatch=4
sam_runtime: implementing selector tweak now. quick patch:
```
if (abs(runtime_rope_scale - kernel_expected_scale) <= 0.02) {
  choose(optimized_kernel);
} else {
  choose(fallback);
}
```
lee_ml: also add telemetry: tag requests where kernel mismatch occurs, include head_kv shape, rope_scale, quant_profile.
ana_sre: add alert if fallback rate > 0.5% over 5m for p95-sensitive routes.
jordan_perf: after patch, re-run sweep, and run end-to-end eval on calibration set. if latency drop restores within 3% of baseline and accuracy delta unchanged, ship.
sam_runtime: pushed PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/842
deploy-bot: ci status: all checks green for PR 842; staging deploy scheduled
sam_runtime: will report back with new numbers in ~2h. tagging @jordan_perf @lee_ml for visibility :mag:
lee_ml: thanks — also add a short note in the perf playbook about kernel-rope interactions.
